activation_decision.reason: The inspected development ablation improved Recall@5 but did not improve overall Hit@1, regressed six paired Hit@1 cases, and increased irrelevant results. Discovery remains explicit, removable, and outside MCP and default Context until a frozen held-out gate passes.

external_proof.reason: The v0.5.0 candidate and protocol are frozen. Ten real external suite runs, pre-delivery hidden commitments, and two independent signed evaluator attestations remain outstanding.

limitations: The public LongMemEval-S sample was inspected and used for development, so it is not held-out evidence.
The 100000-Asset diagnostics use synthetic identifiers and do not establish semantic quality.
The preserved Legal Pack smoke snapshot binds the v0.4.0 implementation and is historical evidence, not a fresh v0.5.0 legal release rebuild.
No external hidden-label run or independent attestation exists for v0.5.0.
This candidate does not support a universal or cross-system superiority claim.
